scope: One final read-only code/source-label review. No model execution or code edits. No storage re-review. Model outputs not consulted for this review.

verified.roles_and_scopes: Per-parent groups and (role,name) repetition keys preserve separation. No first-duplicate answer selection.
verified.repeated_values: All occurrence lines retained; equal successor names deduplicated only in value summary, conflicting or unresolved occurrences retained.
verified.opaque_and_partial: Opaque slots prevent bridging; incomplete tail lacks end; virtualized hints withhold adjacency/end; membership_complete requires proven terminal.
verified.escapes: Decoded literal Crème and raw escaped ranges remain consistent; graph strings are separately marked nonquotable.
verified.question_independence: project_sources/_source_graph receive delivered items/parsed groups only; no question/truth/accepted-answer input.

limits: Bounded parser/control verification is not proof for every arbitrary malformed tree. Conservative unresolved relations are intentional.
No claim of model adherence, full quote entailment, autonomous-agent success, or memory benefit; live48-call qualification decides only its frozen gate.
Frozen literal substring criterion does not imply semantic quote entailment or requested-source binding.
conclusion: No actionable Important/Critical code or source-label defect found within requested focus. Do not infer qualification before actual48 results and frozen acceptance.
